method: Single-unit initial selection groups at gameloops up to 256, joined by packed unit tags to tracker SUnitBornEvent names. R5 uses shift 18; the reference uses shift 22.
limitations: These are actual observed numeric differences, not a verified complete migration table.
Packed instance tags and unit-type catalog links are different data; correcting the tag packing does not repair these links.
A different match's tracker does not identify the unit instances created while replaying TEN_GREYMANE.
No command flags, ability links, synchronization checksums or game rules were changed based on these observations.
